sourceWindow: 2026-04-24 through 2026-07-19; archived data, no live refresh

bootstrap.cluster: whole game; both teams and all stages receive the same draw weight
bootstrap.interval: pointwise percentile 95%; fixed observed cohort; not simultaneous; suppressed below 95% valid draws

scope: Receiving team, original seven throughout each included possession, no within-possession timeout, goal/turnover outcomes, prior reviewed clock exclusions. All first possessions are included, not only points eventually regained. Graphs 1,3,4 start at least 60 yards from goal; graph 2 uses all known starts. The team map compares first and second; the other figures include third or later possessions.
limits: Field position is first recorded throwing location, not verified pickup; grouped positions are not exact matching.
Later possessions are selected by losing and regaining the disc. These plots do not establish fatigue or any causal effect.
Centering remains in observed throw counts; no automatic film classification is applied. A separate centering-sensitivity figure was omitted at the user’s request.
Early-huck timing remains on hold pending comparable attacking-throw definitions.
Recorded lineup continuity is not independent film verification of every substitution.
